read.thesis: Bank of America Q1 2026: EPS $1.11 (+25%), ROTCE 16%, NII guide raised to +6–8% for 2026, CET1 down 14bp to 11.2% as buybacks ran ahead of earnings; benign credit, steady expense growth.

triggers.label: NII growth guide raised to 6-8%

triggers.label: Deposit rate paid down 16bp to 1.47%
